verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a hosted MCP server that gives AI assistants direct access to project data, so an agent can query events, funnels, flows and retention in natural language (docs-10, docs-19, probe-3). Agents can also use the Query API, which returns the same calculated results as the web reports, plus JQL for custom JavaScript queries and the Raw Event Export API for event-level data (docs-39, docs-43, docs-37, docs-40, docs-9). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents answering growth questions through MCP or the API, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
